fact: Attorney-General Alpha Sesay said Sierra Leone has no enacted data protection law and its data protection framework "remains at Bill stage".

Sierra Loaded reports that on 2 July 2026 a parliamentary committee and the Chief Minister backed the proposed Data Protection Bill, which CHRDI says is still being drafted with the Ministry of Information and Civic Education.
Minister Bah said Cabinet approved a national Data Protection Policy and a Data Protection and Access to Information Bill will soon go to Parliament.

fact: Lawyer Joseph Fitzgerald Kamara writes in the Sierra Leone Telegraph that the country has no comprehensive data protection law in force and urges the government to enact the Data Protection Bill.
The same op-ed says Sierra Leone has no independent privacy regulator.
